name: prototype
description: Build throwaway prototypes to flesh out a design. Duplicate existing components, wire to variant switcher.

steps.name: Detect prototype branch
steps.instruction: Determine which prototype branch to use. Logic: purely functional behavior to validate (build a TUI or CLI app). UI: visual/layout changes to compare (duplicate existing components, wire to variant switcher). Design: design token or theme exploration (toggle panel). Read the project's taste profile if available. For Design branch: load design-sensibility.md for token constraints, density spectrum, and interaction model. Prototypes must evaluate real dense tables, forms, empty/error states, and narrow layouts.
checklist: Existing components identified for duplication (if UI branch)
Design-sensibility loaded for Design branch prototypes

steps.name: Scaffold prototype
steps.instruction: Never create standalone artifacts or isolated files when existing components can be duplicated. For UI prototypes: find the existing component(s) being redesigned, duplicate them in-place (or in a prototype directory alongside the originals), and wire to a variant switcher so all design variations can be toggled and compared in context. The variant switcher pattern: a single control that swaps between original and N prototype variants, rendered in the actual app layout. For logic prototypes: throwaway script or TUI. For design: toggle panel with token overrides.
checklist: Prototype runs in actual app context

steps.name: Iterate and compare
steps.instruction: Build out the prototype variations. Each variation should be meaningfully different - not just color tweaks but structural alternatives. Present side-by-side via the variant switcher. Capture what was learned. The prototype is throwaway - don't polish, don't test, don't document.
checklist: Each variation evaluated against interaction states (hover, focus-visible, active, selected, disabled, loading, error, success)
Dense/narrow/empty/error layouts tested, not just hero screens

steps.name: Extract or discard
steps.instruction: If a variant is chosen: extract it as the new implementation, remove the variant switcher and other variants. If learning was the goal: discard all variants, document what was learned. Clean up prototype artifacts.

tone: Fast and rough. Prototypes validate ideas, not ship code.
